Arithmetic.Definition: An arithmetic operator performs a mathematical computation on one or more numeric values, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division.

Assignment.Definition: An assignment operator stores a value into a variable or target expression.

Bitwise.Definition: A bitwise operator performs an operation directly on the individual bits of a numeric value, treating it as a sequence of binary digits.

BooleanLogical.Definition: A boolean logical operator combines or inverts boolean values to produce a new boolean result.

Comparison.Definition: A comparison operator tests the ordering relationship between two values and produces a boolean result.

Equality.Definition: An equality operator tests whether two values are considered equal or not equal, producing a boolean result.

ExpressionBodyArrow.Definition: The expression body arrow ({c:keyword}=>{/c}) introduces the expression body of a member, indicating that the member's implementation is provided by the expression that follows.

IndexFromEnd.Definition: The index-from-end operator ({c:keyword}^{/c}) specifies a position counted from the end of a sequence, where {c:code}^1{/c} refers to the last element.

Indirection.Definition: An operator that accesses or produces a value indirectly through a memory address, such as obtaining an address or dereferencing a pointer.

Lambda.Definition: The lambda operator ({c:keyword}=>{/c}) separates the parameter list of a lambda expression from its body.

MemberAccess.Definition: The member access operator ({c:keyword}.{/c}) navigates to a specific member of a type, namespace, or instance.

NamespaceAlias.Definition: The namespace alias operator ({c:keyword}::{/c}) accesses a type or namespace within an aliased namespace, such as {c:code}global::{/c} to reference types in the global namespace.

NullCoalescing.Definition: The null-coalescing operator ({c:keyword}??{/c}) returns the left-hand value if it is not {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c}, or the right-hand value if it is.

NullCoalescingAssignment.Definition: The null-coalescing assignment operator ({c:keyword}??={/c}) assigns the right-hand value to the target only if the target is currently {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c}.

NullConditionalDot.Definition: The member access component of the null-conditional operator ({c:keyword}?.{/c}). It accesses the specified member only when the preceding value is not {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c}.

NullConditionalQuestion.Definition: The null-guard component of the null-conditional operator ({c:keyword}?.{/c}). It short-circuits the expression and returns {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c} if the preceding value is {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c}.

NullForgiving.Definition: The null-forgiving operator ({c:keyword}!{/c}) tells the compiler that a value should be treated as non-null. It does not change runtime behavior.

OperatorDeclaration.Definition: The operator symbol in an operator overload declaration, identifying which built-in operator this method provides a custom implementation for.

PatternMatchArrow.Definition: The pattern match arrow ({c:keyword}=>{/c}) connects the pattern of a {c:color-purple keyword}switch{/c} expression arm to the value returned when that pattern matches.

RangeSlice.Definition: The range operator ({c:keyword}..{/c}) defines a range of indices for extracting a contiguous portion of a sequence. Either or both endpoints can be omitted to indicate the start or end of the sequence.

Shift.Definition: A shift operator moves the bits of a numeric value left or right by a specified number of positions.

TernaryColon.Definition: Prefixes the value or expression that is returned when the ternary condition evaluates to {c:bold}false{/c}.

TernaryQuestion.Definition: Prefixes the value or expression that is returned when the ternary condition evaluates to {c:bold}true{/c}.
